evals.name: open-debate-build-ship
evals.prompt: we need a new feature for the game. have a few agents debate what's worth adding, pick the winner and build it, then merge to main. don't ask me anything
evals.expected_output: Four debaters propose and vote, the judge writes a decision record naming the winner and the rejected ideas, one builder ships the winner with a Playwright test, main is fast-forwarded and pushed with the cache bumped, README updated, decisions/ record committed, artifact republished; the report names the winner, the vote, the losers, and asks no question.
assertions: main on origin advanced past the base commit
all Playwright tests in test/ pass on origin's main
exactly one feature landed (one feature/* merge), not a batch
a decision record was committed under decisions/ naming the winner and at least two rejected proposals with reasons
sw.js CACHE version was bumped exactly once
README.md was updated to describe the shipped feature and lists decisions/
test coverage grew: at least one file under test/ was added or changed
no dependencies or external resources were added (no package.json, no external script/link)
during a round nothing on screen gives the answer away (learning rule kept; a test checks it when the feature involves questions)
working clone left clean: no feature/* branches and no extra worktrees
final report names the winner, the vote, and the losers with reasons, and asks no question

evals.name: focused-words-mode
evals.prompt: What should we add to the words mode next? Argue it out between a few different perspectives, take a decision, implement it and ship it to main.
evals.expected_output: Same as the open run but every proposal serves the words mode and a language-teacher specialist joins the debate; the winner extends test/words.js or adds a words test, and the learning rule is explicitly checked.
assertions: main on origin advanced past the base commit
all Playwright tests in test/ pass on origin's main
the shipped feature belongs to the words mode
a fifth specialist lens (language teacher) took part in the debate
a decision record was committed under decisions/ naming the winner and at least two rejected proposals with reasons
sw.js CACHE version was bumped exactly once
test/words.js or a new words test was changed and checks that no answer is on screen during play
working clone left clean: no feature/* branches and no extra worktrees
final report asks no question

evals.name: decide-only
evals.prompt: /feature-debate --decide-only something that makes kids come back tomorrow
evals.expected_output: The debate runs and a decision record is printed in the final message with a winner, acceptance criteria, and rejected proposals; nothing is built, committed or pushed, and the repo is untouched.
assertions: the working tree and every branch are unchanged (no new commits, no worktrees, no decisions/ file)
the final message contains a decision record with a winner, acceptance criteria and at least two rejected proposals with reasons
every proposal in the record serves the focus (replay value / coming back tomorrow)
four lenses (child, teacher, parent, engineer) each proposed and voted
final report asks no question
